description: Sale Record (for SELLERS): after each x402 sale, your middleware sends the tx hash (or PAYMENT-RESPONSE) + the route sold. OMENZ checks the payment really settled on Base to the payTo your route advertises right now, counts it once, and returns a signed sale receipt. Verified sales and distinct payers show in your public Seller Track Record, which buyers see in OMENZ Checkout before paying. Proof of real sales, not claims. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/sale/record, $0.001 via x402.)
